label: Bible Study
prompt: Bear ye one another's _____, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verse: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
note: Shared weight is lighter weight — Paul calls that fulfilling the law of Christ.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the _____ of thine heart.
verse: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
note: Delight comes first, then the desires — and the delight tends to reshape what you desire.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me _____.
verse: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
note: Peter swore he'd never deny Jesus; the KJV's 'thrice' came true before the cock crowed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a _____ people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verse: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
note: 'Peculiar' here means God's own possession, not odd — though the world may struggle to tell the difference.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For godly sorrow worketh _____ to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verse: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
note: Godly sorrow 'worketh repentance'; worldly sorrow just works death. Paul's reminder that regret isn't repentance.
